messages:
maya: Kickoff: need a compact spec for onboarding lanes + pilot offer. Goal: sell predictable migrations while keeping bench budget sane. Proposal: three lanes (experimental, standard, pinned) + pilot terms for 3 tenants.
ashok: Metric guardrails: standard/pinned require latency_p95_delta <= 12% and semantic_fidelity >= 0.88 on a 2k-sample eval. Experimental = 200-sample smoke only.
kevin: Sales asks: two pricing tiers for pin windows: 90d (light migration help + 10% credit) and 180d (full migration support + 20% credit). Pilot gets temporary 30% migration credit.
samir: Operational constraints: bench capacity supports 3 concurrent full benches or ~18 experimental benches. Recommend cap pilot to 2 full or 6 experimental at once.
lina: Pilot timeline: 4-week pilot per tenant. Want a single-console view showing lane, bench progress, acceptance metrics, rollback button.
maya: Rollout controls: shadowing for 1h then gradual ramp 0->10->50->100 with 30m observation windows. Auto-rollback if semantic_fidelity drops >10% or error-rate >3x baseline in 1h.
ashok: I'll provide the small eval script and webhook events: catalog.migration.status states. ops-bot: feature-branch deployed: branch=onboard-lanes-1739990000, preview-console=on.
kevin: I'll prepare pilot SOW and credits. samir: I'll book canary capacity and add alert thresholds. lina: I'll shortlist customers and comms.
maya: Action items: ashok +1d metric code; samir +1d bench reservation; kevin +2d SOW; lina +2d pilot comms. If no objections I'll lock and PR the spec. :thumbsup:
